text: dsh-personal-settings 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的个性化设置插件，在设置页加入指令与记忆两个标签。它让你编辑全局 AGENTS.md，查看、搜索、创建、修改和删除 dsh-auto-memory 保存的长期记忆，也能切换会话结束时的自动提炼。指令保存在本机 DSH_HOME 下，记忆功能需要配合 dsh-auto-memory；适合想在一个页面维护跨会话上下文的 DSH 用户。

dsh-personal-settings adds instruction and memory tabs to DSH web settings. Edit global instructions, browse and manage long-term memories, and toggle automatic extraction at session end. Local instructions use DSH_HOME; memory features require dsh-auto-memory.
我想在 DSH 设置里直接编辑每次新会话都会加载的全局指令。
有没有办法在一个页面里搜索和整理跨会话保存的记忆？
I want to browse and edit the long-term memories saved for my DSH sessions.
dsh-personal-settings 的功能「全局指令编辑」：在个性化设置的指令标签读取并编辑本机 AGENTS.md，显示字节预算并保存更改，供后续会话使用。
dsh-personal-settings 的功能「长期记忆管理」：在记忆标签浏览、搜索、筛选并新建、编辑或删除 dsh-auto-memory 记录，也可切换会话结束时的自动提炼。

dsh-personal-settings README · dsh-personal-settings：中文 | [English](README.en.md)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 加一个「个性化」设置页：**一个地方管长期指令和长期记忆**。

DSH 本身只会自动加载 `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`，没有任何界面；记忆要靠第三方插件，而它们的面板是独立入口。这个插件把两件事收进同一个页面：

- **指令** — 直接编辑 `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`，也就是每个新会话自动注入的那份
- **记忆** — 浏览、搜索、新建、编辑、删除 `dsh-auto-memory` 存下的记忆，外加一个自动提炼开关

dsh-personal-settings README · 为什么：| | 原生 DSH | 这个插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 改全局指令 | 自己找文件、自己编辑 | 设置页里直接写，带字节预算条 |
| 看有哪些记忆 | 翻 `~/.dsh/memory` | 列表 + 搜索 + 类型/作用域 |
| 自动提炼记忆 | 改 YAML 后重启 | 页面上有开关 |

dsh-personal-settings README · 安装：需要 DSH `0.2.x`。记忆部分依赖 [`dsh-auto-memory`](https://github.com/AskTheWay/dsh-auto-memory)，先装它：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-auto-memory
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:XEsx630/dsh-personal-settings"
```

或者用本地目录：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:/path/to/dsh-personal-settings"`。

装完重启 DSH，设置里会出现「个性化」。

dsh-personal-settings README · 可选：去掉 dsh-auto-memory 自带的侧边栏入口：`dsh-auto-memory` 会挂一个自己的「记忆」侧边栏面板，和本插件的记忆标签重复。想合并成一个入口，用仓库里的脚本做一份只保留宿主的副本：

```sh
node scripts/headless-memory.mjs desktop
```

它会复制已安装的包、删掉 `lib/client.js` 和 `package.json` 里的 `dsh.client`，然后打印两条替换安装的命令。宿主能力（索引注入、`memory_*` 工具、`/api/auto-memory/*`、自动提炼）全部保留。
section: 可选：去掉 dsh-auto-memory 自带的侧边栏入口

text:
dsh-personal-settings README · 指令：编辑 `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`（默认 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`）。保存后：

- **新会话**第一步就带上
- **当前会话**在下一次文件操作后由内置的 `dsh-agent-instructions` 重新读取

右下角的字节数是按文件估算的，参考预算是 65,536 字节；超过 80% 进度条转琥珀色。

dsh-personal-settings README · 记忆：列表按「固定优先 → 更新时间」排序，支持按关键词和全局/工作区筛选。点一行进入独立编辑页：

- 名称只能是 `a-z0-9-`，创建后不可改（它就是文件名）
- 描述必填，会进 `MEMORY.md` 索引
- 类型决定列表里的色点：用户 / 反馈 / 项目 / 参考
- 「固定」的记忆在注入预算紧张时优先保留

dsh-personal-settings README · 自动记忆：页面顶部的开关控制 `dsh-auto-memory` 的 `autoSummarize`：

- 打开后，**会话结束时**后台用当前模型从对话里提炼值得长期保留的事实，最多 5 条
- 开关写的是 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，然后调用 cordis loader **只重启 `auto-memory` 这一个条目**，不用重启整个 DSH
- 加载器不可用时会退回「重启后生效」，配置本身已经落盘，不会丢

dsh-personal-settings README · 数据在哪：| 内容 | 路径 |
|---|---|
| 全局指令 | `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` |
| 记忆文件 | `$DSH_HOME/memory/_user/*.md`、`$DSH_HOME/memory/--<项目>--/*.md` |
| 记忆索引 | 同目录 `MEMORY.md` |
| 注入审计 | `$DSH_HOME/memory/audit.jsonl` |

全是普通 Markdown，能手改、能进 git。

dsh-personal-settings README · 安全：- 两条宿主路由（`/dsh-personalization/api/*`）只接受回环 Host，写指令单次上限 256 KiB
- 指令文件用临时文件 + rename 落盘，不会留下写了一半的文件
- 偏好设置只做**两件事**：把 `autoSummarize: true|false` 写进 profile 的 patch，然后重启那一个条目；非法请求直接 400
- 客户端不发任何网络请求，只调本机接口

dsh-personal-settings README · 已知限制：- 记忆标签依赖 `dsh-auto-memory` 的宿主接口。只装本插件时，记忆相关功能会显示「读取失败」，指令标签不受影响
- 自动提炼在 **agent 被释放**时触发（切会话、关会话、退出应用），不是每轮都跑；只读对话里的 user / assistant 文本，不读工具调用与输出
- 客户端的文案目前只有中文
- 开关的热重载依赖 cordis loader 的运行时更新接口，属于内部 API，DSH 大版本升级时可能需要跟着调整

dsh-personal-settings README · 开发：无构建步骤：`client.js` 是手写的 `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle，`index.js` 是普通 Node ESM。

```sh
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
npm pack
```

装本地改动：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:/path/to/dsh-personal-settings"
```

改 `client.js`/`index.js` 后要重启 DSH 才会生效（link 安装不用重新装，但进程里的模块不会热更新）。

dsh-personal-settings README · dsh-personal-settings：One **Personalization** settings page for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): keep long-lived instructions and long-lived memory in the same place.

[中文](README.md) | English

Today DSH auto-loads `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` but ships no UI for them, and memory comes from separate plugins with separate panels. This plugin puts both behind one settings section:

dsh-personal-settings README · dsh-personal-settings：- **Instructions** — edit `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`, the file injected at the start of every new session
- **Memory** — browse, search, create, edit and delete what `dsh-auto-memory` has stored, plus a switch for automatic extraction

dsh-personal-settings README · Why：| | Stock DSH | This plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Edit global instructions | Find the file yourself | Edit in place, with a byte-budget bar |
| See what was remembered | Browse `~/.dsh/memory` | List + search + type/scope |
| Turn on auto-extraction | Edit YAML, restart | A switch on the page |

dsh-personal-settings README · Install：Requires DSH `0.2.x`. The memory half depends on [`dsh-auto-memory`](https://github.com/AskTheWay/dsh-auto-memory), so install it first:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-auto-memory
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:XEsx630/dsh-personal-settings"
```

Or from a local checkout: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:/path/to/dsh-personal-settings"`.

Restart DSH; **Settings → 个性化 (Personalization)** appears.

dsh-personal-settings README · Optional: drop dsh-auto-memory's own sidebar entry：`dsh-auto-memory` adds its own "memory" sidebar panel, which duplicates this plugin's memory tab. The bundled script builds a host-only copy:

```sh
node scripts/headless-memory.mjs desktop
```

It copies the installed package, removes `lib/client.js` and the `dsh.client` field, then prints the two commands that swap it in. Host behaviour — index injection, `memory_*` tools, `/api/auto-memory/*`, auto-extraction — is untouched.
section: Optional: drop dsh-auto-memory's own sidebar entry

text:
dsh-personal-settings README · Instructions：Edits `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` (`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` by default). After saving:

- **New sessions** pick it up on their first step
- **The current session** rereads it after its next file operation, via the built-in `dsh-agent-instructions`

The byte counter is a per-file estimate against a 65,536-byte reference budget; the bar turns amber past 80%.

dsh-personal-settings README · Memory：Rows sort by pinned first, then most recently updated. Filter by text and by user/project scope. Clicking a row opens a dedicated editor:

- `name` is limited to `a-z0-9-` and cannot change after creation — it is the filename
- `description` is required and feeds the `MEMORY.md` index
- `type` drives the colour dot: user / feedback / project / reference
- Pinned memories are the last to be dropped when the injection budget is tight

dsh-personal-settings README · Auto-memory：The switch at the top controls `dsh-auto-memory`'s `autoSummarize`:

- When on, at the **end of a session** the current model distils up to five durable facts from the transcript in the background
- The switch writes the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, then asks the cordis loader to **restart only the `auto-memory` entry** — no full DSH restart
- If the loader is unavailable it falls back to "restart required"; the config is already on disk either way

dsh-personal-settings README · Where the data lives：| Content | Path |
|---|---|
| Global instructions | `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` |
| Memory files | `$DSH_HOME/memory/_user/*.md`, `$DSH_HOME/memory/--<project>--/*.md` |
| Memory index | `MEMORY.md` in the same directory |
| Injection audit | `$DSH_HOME/memory/audit.jsonl` |

Plain Markdown: hand-editable, greppable, git-friendly.

dsh-personal-settings README · Security：- Both host routes (`/dsh-personalization/api/*`) accept loopback `Host` headers only; instruction writes are capped at 256 KiB
- Instruction saves go through a temp file + rename, so a crash never leaves a half-written `AGENTS.md`
- The settings route does exactly two things: writes `autoSummarize: true|false` into the profile patch, then restarts that one entry; anything else is a 400
- The client makes no network requests beyond local routes

dsh-personal-settings README · Known limitations：- The memory tab needs `dsh-auto-memory`'s host routes. With only this plugin installed it shows a read error; the instructions tab is unaffected
- Auto-extraction fires when an **agent is disposed** (session switch, close, app exit), not every turn; it reads user/assistant text only, never tool calls or tool output
- UI copy is currently Chinese only
- Hot-restarting the entry relies on cordis loader's runtime update API — an internal interface that may shift on major DSH upgrades

dsh-personal-settings README · Development：No build step: `client.js` is a hand-written `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle, `index.js` is plain Node ESM.

```sh
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
npm pack
```

Install a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:/path/to/dsh-personal-settings"
```

Edits to `client.js`/`index.js` need a DSH restart — a link install keeps the files live, but the running process does not hot-reload modules.
